name: Cedar Mill Credit Fund
subStrategy: Senior secured lending to lower mid-market businesses

terms.couponNote: Quarterly cash, paid on called capital. Tiered by commitment: 9% at $50k, 10% at $150k, 11% at $500k.

tiers.source: FICTIONAL. Invented to show how a tiered preferred return reads.

structure: Senior secured loans to established smaller businesses. The cash coupon is what this is bought for; the capital comes back rather than multiplying.

sections.title: What it is
sections.body: A private credit fund paying a quarterly cash coupon, with the rate set by how much you commit.
